🚀 Launched
SystemStats GPU Ring — 2026-08-30
GPU utilization joins CPU, memory, disk and network. It is read from the busiest IOAccelerator's PerformanceStatistics, tolerating the key rename across generations, and a machine that publishes neither spelling reports no GPU rather than a false zero. Sampling moved into SystemStatsSampler, which returns nil rather than zero when a source has no answer yet, so a failed syscall no longer renders as "idle".
Semantic Shelf Search, Working — 2026-08-30
SQLiteVecIndex.upsert inserted against a filtered query, which is not a valid INSERT target, so every insert threw and the shelf fell back to substring matching without saying so. With that fixed, queries are answered from an in-memory mirror of L2-normalized vectors: top-5 over 10k items went from 1239 ms to 12 ms. Re-indexing is incremental — items carry a hash of the text they were indexed from, so an unchanged shelf costs no embedding calls.
Plugin SDK — 2026-08-30
The public plugin API is frozen and published. NotchPluginCore is the SDK product: it holds the protocol, the context and the descriptor, and depends on no plugin. Capability narrowing is now enforced rather than advisory — each service accessor returns a facade conforming to one sub-protocol, so a plugin cannot cast back up to reach services it never declared, and an external plugin receives only the groups its descriptor lists. examples/HelloPlugin builds and tests with plain swift build, which is the standing check that the SDK stays consumable without Tuist.
machNotch Architecture Hardening — 2026-06-13
The June 2026 hardening pass shipped: app @main shim split, per-plugin build targets, app-facing plugin facade bridges, strict descriptor-based on-demand plugin loading, external descriptor discovery prep, and default AudioKit-free builds with Soundscape behind an explicit opt-in target — built then with a Bazel label, now with task build:soundscape against the machNotchWithSoundscape target in Apps/machNotch/Project.swift.
v1.3.2 — 2026-05-16
- Release pipeline unbroken: Codesign now uses the correct rules_apple bundle path (bazel-bin/Apps/machNotch/machNotch_archive-root/machNotch.app) — root cause of the v1.2.0/v1.3.0/v1.3.1 release-build failures. - Release dry-run on every main push: Packaging and codesign regressions caught pre-tag; release SHA matches build SHA; cancel-in-progress: false prevents split-state releases. - CI hardening: Consolidated Bazel cache keys + Bazelisk binary cache; swift-format strict mode enabled with cleared baseline; tag pattern restricted to semver; arch-check SRC path corrected; CodeQL Swift moved to manual dispatch. - Teleprompter UI cleanup (closes #11): Final polish — readingAreaHeightMultiplier extraction and ActionBarSecondaryStyle relocation complete the cleanup tracked across prior sessions. - Note: v1.3.1 was tagged on 2026-05-15 but its release build failed at codesign and produced no artifact. v1.3.2 supersedes it.
v1.3.0 — 2026-05-10
- PluginUIContext: New environment type resolves DIP violations — plugin views no longer depend directly on NotchViewModel. All built-in plugin views migrated. - mach.brief Phase 1+2: App Group infrastructure for cross-app settings sync; vocabulary level system with onboarding picker; word cache and offline fallback. - Bazel native build: Full migration to native Bazel rules for machNotch and XPC service bundle. Taskfile.yml replaces Makefile. - macOS 26 compatibility: Fixed XCTest async teardown crashes across multiple test files; switched CI to macos-26 runner. - Fixes: Bluetooth permission suppression; persistent TCC/accessibility sentinel; Calendar compact access prompt; stats UInt64 underflow guard.
v1.2.0 — 2026-05-03
First public release. - Plugin System: PluginManager + NotchPlugin protocol. All core features (Music, Battery, Calendar, Shelf, Weather, Webcam) are standalone plugins. - Teleprompter Pro: Countdown timer, mic monitoring, hover-to-pause, keyboard shortcuts, AI text refinement. - Habit Tracker: Daily tracking with streaks, progress rings, and persistent storage. - Pomodoro Timer: Work/break intervals, session history, notch-integrated controls. - Browser Extension: Safari extension for media controls and SoundCloud metadata. - Local API & notchctl: HTTP + WebSocket server for external integrations; machnotch:// URL scheme; App Intents for Siri Shortcuts. - AI Subsystem: Foundation Models by default with oMLX as an advanced localhost provider. - SOLID/DDD hardening: 300+ singleton sites removed; PluginID enum; DisplayPrioritizer; @Observable migration. - Performance: Background service backoff, AnyView elimination, GPU/CoreAnimation gating, high-frequency leaf view isolation. ---
🚀 Build System
Migrated off Bazel — 2026-08-30
Bazel was replaced by Tuist. It was priced for a scale this repo does not have: one developer, two apps, ~100k lines. What it cost, all of it visible in the repo it left behind — an 83 KB lockfile, a pinned rules_apple patch for the xctestrun template, rules_swift_package_manager as a bridge to consume SwiftPM packages, three cache steps duplicated across every CI job, and an Xcode workspace demoted to "navigation only". Carried over: the plugin-per-module boundary, the Soundscape opt-in split, and the AudioKit-free guarantee — now checked with task verify:no-soundscape, which inspects the built binary instead of the build graph. Found during the migration, all pre-existing: - The XPC helper's bundle id never matched XPCHelperClient.serviceName, so the privileged helper could not connect in a Bazel build. Restored to the value the committed Xcode project used. - AudioKit and SoundpipeAudioKit were declared dependencies with no first-party imports. Dropped. - PomodoroTimerTests read and wrote the user's real ~/Library/Application Support/machNotch/pomodoro.json. Bazel's sandbox hid it; the store is now injectable and tests use a temp file.
